messages:
Jia: Heads up — quick idea: add route-level permission hints in the Route details panel. Microcopy like 'Can deploy this route' or 'Requires Route Admin' with a hover explainer. Tie it to telemetry to measure confusion and support tickets. Reduce onboarding friction. Thoughts?

Kevin: @Jia i like the idea but caution: we can't run a full auth check per row. Need precomputed effective-perm cache per session and a conservative TTL. :thinking:

Olivia: Love the microcopy approach. Keep it short. Prefer a tiny badge with an info hover instead of huge banners. Also prefer action phrasing ("Can create routes") vs passive verbs.

Sam: Telemetry plan: emit events route_perm_hint_shown, route_perm_hint_clicked, route_perm_help_open. Include fields: org_id, route_id, variant, sample_rate. Suggest sampling: 5% for self-serve, 100% for enterprise during canary.

Jia: Nice @Sam. Let's run an A/B with two variants: V1 = explicit role name, V2 = action-oriented copy + example. Measure help clicks + perm-related support tickets. Need backend flag for canary rollout.

Kevin: API suggestion: add optional field to route summary API: effective_permission_hint with minimal shape so clients can opt-in. e.g. {status:'ok'|'missing', suggested_role:'Route Admin'}. Keep it optional to avoid breaking clients and TTL=60s cache.

Sam: Also important: do not leak admin-only details to users who don't have view perms. Show generic 'Contact admin' if the caller can't view role mapping.

Olivia: Microcopy options — A) "You can deploy this route" B) "Admins can deploy this route". I vote A for empowerment. Keep hover = 1 sentence, then link to docs.

Jia: @Kevin can you mock the API payload and confirm caching strategy? Also GDPR question: telemetry must avoid user PII.

Kevin: Sure, example payload:```json
{
  "route_id": "r-123",
  "effective_permission_hint": "missing",
  "suggested_role": "Route Admin",
  "ttl_seconds": 60
}
```

Kevin: We'll return the field only when the feature flag is on and the caller has minimal view rights. Cache at CDN edge for 60s, invalidate on role changes.

Sam: On telemetry GDPR: ok to include org_id and hashed_anon_id, but strip actual user emails/ids. Use hashed bucket_id for experiments.

Jia: Decision proposal: Canary in prod: 10% of enterprise orgs, 1% of self-serve. Gate by feature flag rbac-route-hint-canary. @Kevin add the API flag, @Olivia prepare microcopy variants, @Sam add telemetry schema.

Kevin: I'll add an opt-in feature flag and a small patch to the route-summary endpoint. Will open PR today.

Olivia: I'll put copy variants and hover mock in Figma and link here when done. :thumbsup:

ReleasesBot: deploy-bot: feature flag created: rbac-route-hint-canary (10% enterprise, 1% self-serve).

Sam: I'll create telemetry ticket and attach the event schema + redaction rules.

Jia: Thanks all — follow-up sync Friday to review initial metrics and support volume.
